integrity: The result is proved from the exact separated-variable identity using elementary exponential inequalities and dominated convergence. High-precision quadrature was used only as a finite stress check, not as proof. The qualitative distinction between divided and undivided equations in the 2024 predecessor is explicitly credited rather than claimed as new.
limitations: The theorem treats the scalar deterministic equation for C>0 and alpha>0. The p>1 limit is locally uniform only away from rescaled time zero, and the first-order state expansion is asserted only on compact critical-time intervals bounded away from zero. Equivalent quantitative estimates may exist in unindexed literature under another normalization.
title: Critical \(1/\alpha\) time scale and quantitative logarithmic-integral limit for nonlinear relaxation
